_evidence: 0x005174cb (compose after fuzz:i32): the mode byte [0x7c2ea9] is tested for the sign ('test 0xff; jns'), bit 6 ('test 0x40; jne') and the value 2 ('cmp 2; je'), so it draws negative, bit-6 and 2 values besides others; [0x7c2e75] is compared with 0xff ('cmp 0xff; jne'): 0xff about half the time. Both bit-6 and ==2 paths call 0x51d187 with eax = 6: 'test byte [0x66d8a1],0xff; jne clc' then 'bt [0x852d64],6; jae bts..clc' else stc, and 'jb' at 0x51751d/0x517535 returns on CF. Fuzzed, [0x66d8a1] was nonzero in practically every case and [0x852d64] (not referenced by 0x5174cb itself) kept its image value, so CF = 1 never happened. Here [0x66d8a1] is zero in about half the cases and the low byte of the bit set [0x852d64] has bit 6 set in about half (the other three bytes random: bts writes the whole dword back). Flag bytes and a bit set only: every value is valid. Values are synthetic.
